regimeSub: Warsh Jackson Hole speech today as markets brace for hawkish hold amid 3.3% CPI / 1.5% GDP stagflation mix.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh delivers Jackson Hole debut today (Aug 24-25 Reuters/WSJ) → policy tensions with Treasury flagged; markets expect hawkish hold guidance with rates pinned at 3.63% despite 3.3% CPI overshoot

US stagflation entrenched: Q2 GDP 1.5% miss (Jul 30 WSJ), July NFP -23k (Aug 7 CNBC), July retail sales largest drop in year (Aug 14 Census) → consumer buckling while core inflation stays sticky at 3.3%
BOK August rate decision splits 5-4 (Aug 24 Aju Press) → record household debt vs stronger growth creates dilemma; won at 1381 complicates easing bias per Vice Gov Kwon Aug 21 caution
JGB selloff persists (Aug 18 Asahi) amid BOJ Sept hike expectations after Bessent nudge (Aug 5 Reuters); USDJPY 159.16 tests MOF intervention threshold as Takaichi fiscal concerns mount
